relationships.subject: Paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: systemic paclitaxel administration upregulates the expression of neurotrophin-3 (Nt3) mRNA and NT3 protein in the neurons of dorsal root ganglia (DRG), but not in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: NT3
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, NT3 triggers tropomyosin receptor kinase C (TrkC) activation and participates in the paclitaxel-induced increases of C-C chemokine ligand 2 (Ccl2) mRNA and CCL2 protein in the DRG.

relationships.subject: NT3
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking NT3 upregulation attenuates paclitaxel-induced mechanical, heat, and cold nociceptive hypersensitivities and spontaneous pain without altering acute pain and locomotor activity in male and female mice.

relationships.subject: TrkC
relationships.evidence_quote: NT3 likely contributes to CINP through TrkC-mediated activation of the Ccl2 gene in DRG neurons.

key_findings: Paclitaxel increases NT3 in DRG neurons; blocking it attenuates CINP and DRG NT3 overexpression alone induces hypersensitivity in naive mice.
NT3 acts via TrkC (not p75NTR) to raise CCL2 in DRG.
